answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales with staked capital, effectively creating an economic atlas of trust. Every heartbeat of the network requires a cryptographic pulse to validate transactions, ensuring that each vertex in the graph represents actual financial skin in the game. An attacker must incur massive capital expenditure to gain majority control, making the cost of creating fake identities prohibitively expensive and economically irrational.
